title: Cold rebuild: Compose a logger
summary: Rebuild Compose a logger from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Compose a logger** in *Inheritance and composition*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.title: Rebuild Compose a logger cold
prompt: Write a class `Notifier` that **has** a list of senders. Each sender is any object with a `send(message)` method.
- `notify(message)` calls `send` on each and returns how many senders it called
Also write `ConsoleSender` whose `send` prints `console: MESSAGE`, and `MemorySender` whose `send` appends to its own `sent` list.
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
